Cosmoledo: Giant Trevally on the Fly in Seychelles

Make giant trevally the goal of a Cosmoledo fly fishing trip. Enjoy a remote Seychelles atoll outing with a demanding fish in mind.

KEY FACTS

Blue Safari operates a Cosmoledo Atoll fly-fishing program. This establishes a specific operator lead, not Atlas inventory.

Blue Safari — Cosmoledo Atoll ↗

For giant trevally, Blue Safari describes 11- or 12-weight fly rods with matched reels and a heavy tropical line/backing system. It describes target locations changing through the tidal cycle, rather than one universally best tide.

Blue Safari — Giant trevally on fly ↗

Giant trevally is recorded in the fishery source.

Fishery source for Cosmoledo Atoll ↗

The operator’s published heavy system includes approximately 300 yards of 80-pound braid backing and a tropical floating fly line with an 80-pound core. Confirm capacity with the exact reel and follow the operator’s current leader/connection instructions. These details apply to its GT fly approach, not all flats fishing.

Blue Safari — Giant trevally on fly ↗
SEASON

When this trip makes sense.

No full atoll operating calendar is inferred here. Obtain the operator’s actual departure dates and an explanation of how the week’s conditions affect access. A tide stage is not a guarantee of a fish at a particular place.

Audit the complete outfit

Use the operator’s current equipment list to check rod, reel, backing capacity, fly-line core, leader and connections together. A heavy rod alone does not create a robust system. Do not transfer the source’s GT recommendation to bonefish or to a different fishing method. Practice with the actual outfit and flies before departure, and ask whether rental or backup equipment can reduce purchases.

Choose footwear from the route

Ask how much time is spent on a skiff and on foot, which surfaces are involved and what footwear the operator requires. Fit the boots before travel and check them with the clothing system. Keep heavy personal tackle within the actual transfer allowance. A remote atoll package needs its own baggage plan rather than a standard international airline assumption.

Make secondary targets optional

A species list can tempt customers to buy multiple additional outfits. Confirm whether those targets are realistic priorities during the chosen program and whether gear is supplied. Keep the shopping list focused on the GT setup first. Use source-backed specifications for the technical system and reserve retailer searches for the exact approved variants or personal gear gaps.

LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for Seychelles

No general licence is required for recreational fishing under the published exemption. You cannot sell or trade the catch, and fishing restrictions still apply.

Official rules ↗

Rules for this water

  • Arrange access through the atoll operator; its booking includes conservation contributions.
